title: Far Input Positions Are Blank
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, and let $d\in\mathbb{Z}$. If $|d|>|x|+1$, then the input symbol seen from $c$ at offset $d$ is absent.
